name: Exito Product Bundle
author: Studio EXITO

sections.description:
This lightweight plugin allows WooCommerce store owners to attach a simple product as an addon (bundle) to any single or variable product. Addons are displayed directly on the product page and can be purchased with a single click.

  • Easily select an addon product from the product editor by product ID, product Name
  • Compatible with simple and variable products
  • Lightweight and fast
  • Works with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)
  • Translatable and WPML-compatible

License

Exito Product Bundle is free software licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Go to a product edit screen and choose an Addon Product from the right sidebar
  4. Done! The addon will appear on the product page
sections.faq:
Can I use variable products as addons?

No. Only simple products can be used as addon/bundle products.

Can I customize the position of the addon box?

Yes. You can choose between “above” or “below” the Add to Cart button from the WooCommerce > Addon Products settings.
